id: title:jose-sequeira:flush batch side effects as a consumer background task

review.posthog_relevance: Ingestion throughput and batch integrity preservation
review.reason: Adds a background task return type and scheduled flush before error propagation, allowing the ingestion consumer to continue fetching and processing subsequent batches while scheduled work and broker acknowledgments settle. This could help maintain ingestion throughput and reduce latency for downstream consumers while preserving batch integrity.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the implementation of the scheduled flush and its interaction with the ingestion loop, which is not fully demonstrated by the hunk alone; the actual reduction in latency or prevention of blocking is a consequence of this change rather than an observed outcome.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Adds a background task return type and a scheduled flush before error propagation; the batch is not considered complete until the scheduled work settles.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the ingestion consumer to continue fetching and processing subsequent batches while the scheduled flush and broker acknowledgments settle, preventing the batch-processing loop from blocking on slow tail operations. This could help maintain ingestion throughput and reduce latency for downstream consumers while preserving batch integrity.
